findings.note: Chief patron of HB 1666, which lets a person who lives outside Virginia and lost firearm rights over a felony conviction or certain juvenile findings petition a Virginia circuit court to restore those rights.
subjects: firearm possession by people with prior convictions

findings.note: Listed as a House co-patron (not chief patron) of HB 1420, 'Carrying a concealed handgun; permit not required,' which allows anyone otherwise eligible for a concealed handgun permit to carry a concealed handgun without a permit anywhere he may lawfully carry a handgun openly in Virginia (summary as introduced: https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?231+sum+HB1420).
